Copy your own NI assemblies into this folder before building if automatic detection is not enough.

Required:
- NationalInstruments.DAQmx.dll
- NationalInstruments.Common.dll

Recommended source on your machine:
C:\Program Files (x86)\National Instruments\MeasurementStudioVS2010\DotNET\Assemblies\Current\

After copying, rebuild the project so Visual Studio copies the DLLs next to the EXE.
